thread:
devon: Heads up — premerge SAST gate failing on service-payment. Failing rule: crypto/key-management: missing KMS decrypt privileges on scanner SA.

alex: Oof. Is this the transient RBAC change from yesterday?

devon: Looks like it. Scanner logs show 403 on keystore decrypt. Extract: `ERROR: kms.decrypt: permission denied`

maya: @eng-oncall any recent keystore IAM modifications?

eng-oncall: I rotated a binding for `service-scanner@ci` to remove a stale role. Did not intend to touch KMS grants, but I did an org-wide RBAC policy prune at 15:02 UTC.

lina: That prune probably removed the `cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter` role on the scanner SA. We need a quick rollback or scoped grant.

devon: We have a failing nightly DAST job too — losses in evidence upload. Both are blocking the premerge pipeline. Rolling back RBAC now would be safest.

ops-eli: I can reapply a scoped grant to the scanner SA for the specific keyring used by service-payment. Command: ```
gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding payments-key \n  --location=global --keyring=prod-keys \n  --member=serviceAccount:service-scanner@ci --role=roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter
```

alex: Before we regrant, can we confirm audit logs to show the prune change and the exact binding removed? Need audit evidence for change control. Query: `protoPayload.methodName="SetIamPolicy" AND resource.name:prod-keys`

lina: I'll pull the audit lines and attach in the PR. Need to capture who triggered the prune for the incident record.

security-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-042 (low-impact RBAC prune -> scanner failure). Linked to thread 3032109876.

maya: Temporary mitigation approved: scoped grant to scanner SA for payments-key. Then we run a clean premerge to validate. After that, create a followup to tighten the prune script with an allowlist for scanner service accounts.

eng-oncall: Applied grant at 15:12 UTC. Running `ci/premerge` now.

devon: Premerge passed on first try. :thumbsup: Will open a retro and remediation ticket to update pruning playbook.

alex: Action items: 1) Backfill audit log and assign owner for the prune (lina), 2) Patch prune job to skip scanner SAs (ops-eli), 3) Add automated test so pruning runs in staging first (maya).

lina: Filed SEC-REMEDY-215 with the audit evidence. Also added recommended phrasing for rollback steps into the oncall runbook.

ops-eli: I'll add an allowlist and run it in staging tomorrow 09:00 UTC.

devon: Quick note for SAST/DAST owners: when scanner SAs lose decrypt, we should mark CI failures as 'RBAC/infra' instead of code vuln until validated. Avoid false PR noise.

alex: Good reminder. We should add a check that maps scanner 403s to infra incidents automatically. I'll sketch a tiny mapping rule for the alerts.

security-bot: Closure: mitigation applied, premerge restored. Follow-ups tracked in SEC-REMEDY-215.

devon: Thanks everyone — nice quick triage.
